content:
Rae: Quick note 11:00 UTC 8 0% of onboarding index jobs retried/failing between 10:48-10:58 UTC for a handful of tenants. Pulling list now; want CS to prep outbound and prioritization. @Jon (CS) can you take renewals?

Jon (CS): On it. Which tenants look high-touch?

Rae: Early list: FreshTrial-21, RetailScale-4 (renewal in 9 days), CampusBeta-2. Root cause looks like intermittent writer timeouts after a config flip.

SRE-Lin: Confirmed. There was a write buffer misconfiguration that briefly limited inflight writes. We reverted the config at 10:55 UTC and kicked retries; queue at ~70% drained. No model change.

notify-bot: incident created INC-2026-222. retry-job rj-361234 started.

Jon (CS): Thanks. Draft outbound for trials (short): "Hi <Name>, we saw brief delays processing uploads between 10:48-10:58 UTC that may have affected some items. We've retried pending uploads and are prioritizing impacted accounts. We're sorry for the disruption 60 we'd like to offer a complimentary 60-minute recovery session and a one-time 5% credit. If you still see missing items reply and we'll fast-track manual re-ingest."

Jon (CS): Draft high-touch (RetailScale-4): "Hi <Name>, apologies 50 we prioritized your account after an issue earlier today and retried pending items. To make this right we'd like to offer one month of premium support or a billing credit, plus a 30-minute technical sync with our SRE. Please let us know which you prefer and a good time."

Harper (AE): RetailScale-4 is definitely high risk for renewal. I'll take the high-touch outreach, but want the premium-support option included. Also request billing tag "incident-credit-3612340001" for finance.

SRE-Lin: Queue draining steadily; retries are succeeding at ~98.7%. We'll attach the retry logs to the incident. Also to CS: avoid internal config jargon externally. Suggested one-line root cause for customers: "an internal configuration change briefly impacted uploads; we reverted the change and reprocessed pending items."

Jon (CS): Agreed. I'll send RetailScale-4 the personalized message now and broadcast the trial template in 20 minutes once queue is fully processed. Will include office hours link for recovery sessions.

Rae: Please capture responses in the CS tracker and flag any request for manual re-ingest. Also collect any feedback in the recovery office hours and attach to RCA.

notify-bot: confluence placeholder: https://confluence.redwood/incidents/INC-2026-222/summary

Harper (AE): DMing Jon the concession wording. I'll be CC'd on the RetailScale outreach.

Jon (CS): Sending now. Plan: 1) High-touch outreach immediate for renewal accounts. 2) Standard broadcast for trials after queue drain. 3) Open two recovery office-hours slots and capture feedback. Update execs + ops with a 1-paragraph summary by EOD. :thumbsup:
